title: AC1024 associative distance-constraint node
scope: Decode the witnessed AC1024 version-0 AcDistanceConstraint body, both hard-pointer dependencies, and the conditional distance vector while preserving unsupported variants and strict document-level refusal.

independentLayoutSource.layout: ACDISTANCECONSTRAINT calls read_explicit_constraint(reader, legacy), then reads direction_type as a raw byte and a 3BD distance only when direction_type is nonzero. The legacy source profile omits the active bit.

localRawProbe.method: Forked body and handle streams at the unknown node boundary, read the source-matched fields transactionally, and did not commit probe positions.
localRawProbe.interpretation: ODA v5.4.1 defines code 5 as a hard pointer. Both observed fields are non-null code-5 references; the implementation retains other roles and null-reference variants raw.

independentTargetInspection.limitation: This independent read confirms the target object records and their owners. It does not decode the associative node's class-specific body or qualify consumer meaning.

sections: Bit Codes and Data Definitions, page 7: B, BL, RC and 3BD primitive identities.
Handle References, page 16: code 5 is a hard pointer.

limitations: The decoder accepts only the witnessed pair of non-null code-5 dependencies; unsupported role/null variants remain raw.
The real source reaches AcConstrainedCircle node 17 after this Distance node; Circle and later node bodies remain unsupported.
Full associative closure, DXF serialization, readback and consumer meaning remain unqualified; this receipt has no support-claim effect.

fields: Owner ID and implied flag; active flag explicitly absent.
Value-dependency and dimension-dependency field presence, handle code and 64-bit reference.
Direction type and a separate presence flag plus 3BD vector only when direction type is nonzero.
implementation.failureBehavior: Independent generated controls give each dependency a wrong code separately; each profile remains raw and recovers the following OBJECT. A zero direction type completes with no distance field.
implementation.strictExport: dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized remains active; no DXF output is created.

generatedControls: The exact observed non-null code-5/code-5 pair decodes handles 1210 and 1211, owner/implied fields, direction type 1 and vector (1,0,0).
Wrong value-dependency and wrong dimension-dependency roles each remain raw without committing the forked handle stream; the following object is recovered.
Direction type zero consumes no 3BD payload and stores hasDistance=false independently of its zero-initialized coordinate.

realSourceNormal.result: Trace decodes AcDistanceConstraint 77 with both dependencies and the observed distance, then stops at AcConstrainedCircle 17. Expected strict refusal; no DXF was created.

realSourceAsan.result: Same Distance decoding and Circle boundary; no AddressSanitizer diagnostic and no DXF output.
